notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += NodeParameter` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens of its own; everything visible is the expression below it, reached through NodeParameter and its FeatureBinding. It is the parameter position that the send, terminate and for-loop nodes all use, which is why one member serves a payload, a terminated occurrence and an iterated sequence alike.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription. The pack flags this clause as malformed, but the defect is in TriggerExpression (SYSML21-401) and not in this production.
In line 21 `then send new S() to b;` this member holds `new S()` as the payload and `b` as the receiver — two instances of the same production in one line.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
